enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Close eyes. Turn body onto the right side. Place one arm under the pillow. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket higher. Adjust the pillow. Turn onto the back. Rest both arms beside the body. Turn onto the right side again. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Keep eyes closed. Remain lying still. Turn onto the left side. Reach out and pull the blanket back up. Remain lying still until the alarm sounds.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Reach out an arm and press the alarm clock to stop it. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Swing both legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Raise a hand and press the light switch on. Stand in front of the sink. Turn the tap handle. Put both hands under the running water. Cup water and splash it onto the face. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Pick up the toothbrush. Turn the tap on. Wet the toothbrush under the water. Put the toothbrush down. Pick up the toothpaste tube. Unscrew the cap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Put the toothpaste down. Raise the toothbrush to the mouth. Brush the teeth up and down. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth with water. Turn the tap off. Put the toothbrush back into the holder. Turn the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, preparing coffee with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk and eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Put the items on the counter. Open the cupboard door. Take out a bowl and a plate. Close the cupboard door. Crack the egg into the bowl. Pick up a fork and beat the egg. Pick up a slice of bread. Put the bread into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Pick up the kettle. Walk to the sink. Turn the tap on. Fill the kettle with water. Turn the tap off. Carry the kettle back. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Pick up a mug. Put a spoon of coffee powder into the mug. Wait for the kettle to boil. Press the kettle switch off. Lift the kettle and pour hot water into the mug. Put the kettle down. Take the toast out of the toaster. Put the toast on the plate. Sit down at the table. Pick up the fork and eat the egg. Lift the mug and drink the coffee. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink. Rinse them under the tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt and trousers. Lay them on the bed. Take off the sleepwear. Put on the shirt. Button the shirt. Put on the trousers. Pull up the zip. Fasten the belt. Walk to the dresser. Pick up the socks. Sit on the bed. Pull the socks onto both feet. Stand up. Pick up the shoes from the floor. Put on the left shoe. Tie the laces. Put on the right shoe. Tie the laces. Pick up the work bag from the chair. Open the bag. Put the laptop charger into the bag. Put the notebook and pen into the bag. Zip the bag closed. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Put the phone into the pocket. Pull the fan cord to switch the fan off. Walk out of the bedroom.

Walk out of the apartment door. Pull the door closed. Lock the door with the key. Walk down the corridor. Press the elevator button. Step into the elevator. Press the ground floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk out of the building. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Check the bus arrival time on the phone. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the card on the card reader. Walk down the aisle. Hold the handrail. Get off the bus at the stop. Walk along the pavement. Turn the corner. Walk to the office entrance. Push the glass door open. Step into the office. Walk to the desk. Put the bag down beside the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator: coordinating programs, meeting community partners and running sessions
enriched_activities.desc: Sit down at the desk. Open the work bag. Take out the notebook and pen. Place them on the desk. Open the laptop. Press the power button. Type the login password. Open the email client. Read the new emails. Reply to the emails by typing. Stand up. Walk to the meeting room. Sit at the meeting table. Open the notebook. Take notes with the pen during the partner meeting. Speak to the partner: 'Let's confirm the schedule for next week.' Nod and write down the agreed date. Stand up. Shake hands with the partner. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Open the program spreadsheet on the laptop. Type the updated participant list. Pick up the phone. Call a community partner. Say: 'The session starts at ten on Friday.' End the call. Put the phone down. Stand up. Walk to the activity hall. Arrange the chairs in a circle. Set the sign-in sheet on the table. Greet the participants at the door. Start the session. Speak to the group and give instructions. Hand out the printed materials. Walk among the participants. Answer questions. Collect the sign-in sheet. End the session. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Type the session summary into the laptop. Save the file. Close the laptop.

Stand up from the desk. Put the notebook and pen into the bag. Zip the bag. Pick up the bag. Walk to the office door. Push the door open. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Look at the phone screen. Put the phone back. Step onto the bus. Tap the card on the card reader. Hold the handrail. Get off the bus at the stop. Walk along the pavement. Walk to the apartment building. Push the entrance door open. Press the elevator button. Step into the elevator. Press the floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk to the apartment door. Unlock the door with the key. Push the door open. Step inside. Close the door. Take off the shoes. Put the shoes on the shoe rack. Walk into the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating
enriched_activities.desc: Press the kitchen light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and meat. Close the refrigerator door. Put the items on the counter. Walk to the sink. Turn the tap on. Rinse the vegetables under the water. Turn the tap off. Put the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Pick up the meat. Cut the meat into pieces. Push the cut pieces to one side. Place the pot on the induction cooker. Press the power button on the induction cooker. Press the heat button to set the power. Pour oil into the pot. Wait for the oil to heat. Put the meat into the pot. Pick up the spatula and stir the meat. Put the vegetables into the pot. Add salt and stir. Press the heat button to lower the power. Put the lid on the pot. Open the cupboard door. Take out a plate and a bowl. Close the cupboard door. Press the power button on the induction cooker to switch it off. Pick up the pot. Pour the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit down at the table. Pick up the chopsticks and eat. Stand up. Carry the plate and bowl to the sink. Rinse them under the tap. Press the kitchen light switch off. Walk to the living room.

Walk to the sofa. Sit down on the sofa. Lean back against the cushion. Pick up the TV remote from the coffee table. Press the power button on the remote. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Put the remote down on the sofa armrest. Take the phone out of the pocket. Look at the phone screen. Scroll the phone with the thumb. Put the phone down on the coffee table. Pick up the remote again. Press the volume button. Put the remote down. Cross the legs. Lean back. Pick up the remote. Press the channel button again. Put the remote down. Sit and watch the TV screen. Pick up the mug from the coffee table. Lift the mug and drink. Put the mug down. Pick up the remote. Press the power button to switch the TV off. Put the remote on the coffee table. Stand up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the living room and vacuuming the floor
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the mug from the coffee table. Carry the mug to the kitchen. Put the mug into the sink. Walk back to the living room. Pick up the cushion from the floor. Put the cushion on the sofa. Pick up the magazines from the coffee table. Put the magazines on the shelf. Fold the blanket. Put the folded blanket on the sofa armrest. Walk to the corner. Unwind the vacuum cleaner cord. Plug the cord into the wall socket. Press the power button on the vacuum cleaner. Hold the handle. Push the vacuum cleaner across the floor. Pull it back toward the body. Bend down and push the nozzle under the coffee table. Pull it out. Vacuum along the sofa edge. Vacuum toward the door. Push the vacuum cleaner over the rug. Pull it back. Press the power button to switch it off. Pull the plug out of the socket. Wind the cord around the hooks. Carry the vacuum cleaner back to the corner. Put it down.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to plan next day's community program and reply to emails
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk. Pull out the chair. Sit down on the chair. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Type the login password. Open the email client. Click the inbox. Open the first email. Type a reply. Click send. Open the second email. Type a reply. Click send. Open the calendar program. Click on tomorrow's date. Type the program title into the entry. Type the start time and end time. Type the location of the session. Click save. Open the document with the participant list. Scroll down the list. Type the new names. Delete the cancelled names. Click save. Open the checklist document. Type the items for tomorrow. Move the mouse and click the print preview. Close the laptop lid. Stand up. Push the chair back under the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Press the light switch on. Pull the shower curtain aside. Turn the shower tap on. Put a hand under the water to check the temperature. Turn the tap to adjust the temperature. Step into the shower. Wet the hair under the water. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Open the cap. Pour shampoo into the palm. Put the bottle down. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the body. Put the soap back into the dish. Rinse the body under the water. Turn the shower tap off. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel from the hook. Rub the towel over the hair. Wipe the body with the towel. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Turn the tap on. Wet the toothbrush. Put the toothbrush down. Pick up the toothpaste. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth. Turn the tap off. Hang the toothbrush in the holder. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading with the desk lamp to wind down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Walk to the desk. Press the desk lamp switch on. Pull out the chair. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the book from the desk. Open the book to the marked page. Hold the book with both hands. Read the page. Turn the page with a finger. Read the next page. Turn the page again. Close the book. Put the book down on the desk. Stand up from the chair. Push the chair under the desk. Press the desk lamp switch off. Walk to the bed. Pull back the blanket. Sit on the edge of the bed.

Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up over the body. Place the head on the pillow. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Place one arm under the pillow. Close eyes. Turn onto the left side. Adjust the pillow with a hand. Turn onto the back. Rest both arms along the body. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket higher. Remain lying still. Turn onto the left side. Remain lying still with eyes closed.
